description: This file is a shell script configuring and managing a network protocol called 'unetd' using functions like init_proto, proto_unet_init_config, and related setup/teardown routines. It interacts with system networking tools, JSON utilities, and the ubus bus.

methods.name: proto_unet_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the 'unet' protocol.

methods.name: proto_unet_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 'unet' protocol with specified configuration.

methods.name: proto_unet_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the 'unet' protocol, removing configurations.
